input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (Puzzles vs Zombies). Written 1 October 2025 for the game as it is today. If we change the core game before the build, we'll go through the affected parts with you again in November.

Start date
Kickoff is Monday 3 November 2025. That's the date you gave us after we asked for the pause.

Scenario
We're going with Scenario 1. Its job is retention, not cheap installs: it should filter out players who won't like the game while staying true to the core gameplay. Unlike the Domino Delights playable, the player isn't on rails. They pick whatever items they want off the board and can make several matches if they're good enough.

How a level plays
- The board is a 3D physics pile of items. Items settle and cover each other, so digging uncovers buried matches.
- The player drags items into a tray with 7 slots. Any 3 matching items in the tray clear, and the cleared item is fired at the zombies from the cannon (what you've been calling the rocket launcher, with its projectile). Different items have different abilities: the grenade is powerful, the couch does splash damage, the plushie is weak but funny.
- Zombies walk in towards us.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach us and our HP runs out. That's the only lose state.
- A full tray is not a loss. If all 7 slots fill without a match it counts as a blunder: the tray clears and the surviving zombies enrage, but play goes on.

The board: 8 items
Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Bow.
Every other board item on the pack list is an extra you can swap in, using the editable board you offered. That includes Dynamite, Couch and Pillow, Plushie Bunny and everything else in the Living Room, Survival, Toys, Bathroom, Kitchen, Music Instruments and Garden sets. The hand-off list marks each board item as Default (one of the 8) or Extra.
The reference level we sent on 24 September used Grenade, Couch, Couch and Pillow, Plushie Bunny and Plushie Chick. The 8 above replace that set. The Bow replaces the Dynamite from our earlier list, and the Plushie Chick is the item you called the duck.

Zombies: 4, one animation
Party Girl, Plumber, Magician and Football Player, with one animation: walk. All four are in the Unity package we sent on 26 September (zombies_Characters_UnityPack.zip), so you can re-rig them in Spine from there. More zombies can come later if the scope allows.

Background and cannon
Use the background from the reference level and the cannon with its projectile. Both went to you in the first zip on 24 September.

Sound
- Use: matching, success and failure sounds. They're ours and ready.
- Music: a new track made for the ad, not the in-game track. It's being cut down to a loop and is still to come from us. Music may only start after the player's first tap, per your rule from the Domino playable.
- Rocket and explosion sounds: still to come. The ones in the game come from a sound library and a bought pack, so we can't hand them over. We'll send our own versions.

Formats (as you gave them to us)
- 3D: .fbx (binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (character parts separated for 2D animation)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

What's still coming from us
The hand-off list covers every line of the pack, one row each: whether you already have it (Delivered), whether it's sitting in our outgoing folder ready to send (Ready), or whether it's still owed, and if so what and who on our side has it.

• Claire: 6 FBXs still to send
• Brian: 4 exports, the item icons, the UI, and the 8 music instruments (the 26 Sep zip got cut off on upload)

Two things changed since Brian's notes:

• The recoloured Cactus, Chainsaw and Cone went again on 30 Sep, so they're Ready.

Hi <@PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID>, ahead of the 3 November kickoff, here's what you'll build the ZM3D playable from, plus where the asset pack stands on our side:
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/bd5520e67116950310b6df0a/edit

The brief is written for the game as it is today. If the core changes, we'll go through that part with you in November.
